title: OBJECTIVE OF AYUSH GRID
body_text:
The Ayush Grid project, launched by the Ministry of Ayush, has been envisaged as a comprehensive IT backbone for the Ayush sector with the objective of digitizing service delivery and strengthening transparency, efficiency and governance across healthcare, research, education, drug administration, capacity building and medicinal plants.
Ministry of Ayush, under the Ayush Grid initiative, has developed Ayush Hospital Management Information System (AHMIS) which is compliant with the Ayushman Bharat Digital Mission (ABDM).
The Ayush Grid project serves as the IT backbone of the Ayush sector, driving digital
transformation by integrating advanced technologies such as Artificial Intelligence (AI),
Machine Learning (ML) and others across functional areas i.e. Healthcare, Research &
Development, Education & Awareness etc.
Under this initiative, twenty-four e-governance platforms have been developed and made accessible across the country. The My Ayush Integrated Services Portal (MAISP), the master portal of the Ministry of Ayush, integrates all Ayush-related applications and services into a unified digital ecosystem. An AI-enabled chatbot (Beta version) has also been deployed to assist visitors and enhance user experience. The portal facilitates citizen-centric access to various services and schemes and enables real-time monitoring and data-driven decision-making. (Details available at: maisp.ayush.gov.in)
Similarly, the Ayushman Bharat Digital Mission (ABDM)-compliant Ayush Hospital Management Information System (AHMIS) has been deployed to digitize healthcare delivery and improve the management of Ayush health facilities. The Ayush Anudan Portal has streamlined the submission, processing, approval, and monitoring of funding proposals under various Central Sector Schemes of the Ministry. The AI enabled Ayush Research Portal serves as a centralized digital repository of over 43,000 curated Ayush research publications, facilitating easy access for researchers, practitioners, and policymakers.
The Ayush Nivesh Saarthi Portal serves as a dedicated gateway for domestic and international investors in the Ayush sector, providing comprehensive information to promote investment opportunities. The e-Charak portal functions as a virtual marketplace and information platform for the medicinal plants sector, connecting farmers, collectors, buyers, manufacturers, and exporters integrated with AI assistant for resolving user queries.
Further digital platforms like Ayurveda Grantha Samuccaya Digital Library, developed by Ayush Grid and Ayush Manuscripts Advanced Repository (AMAR), Showcase of Ayurvedic Historical Imprints (SAHI) and E- Medical Heritage Accession (E-Medha) developed by Central Council for Research in Ayurvedic Sciences (CCRAS), Ministry of Ayush help digitizing the ancient texts and manuscripts.
Collectively, all e-governance tools are accessible to everyone and have strengthened service delivery, improved operational efficiency, and enhanced transparency and accountability.
This information was given by Union Minister of State (I/C) for Ayush, Shri Prataprao Jadhav in a written reply in Rajya Sabha today.
***
SR/SV/SG

enrichment.summary: The Ministry of Ayush informed Rajya Sabha that the Ayush Grid project is a comprehensive IT backbone digitizing service delivery across Ayush healthcare, research, education, drug administration and medicinal plants. Twenty-four e-governance platforms have been developed, including the master My Ayush Integrated Services Portal (MAISP), ABDM-compliant Ayush Hospital Management Information System (AHMIS), Ayush Anudan Portal, AI-enabled Ayush Research Portal (43,000+ publications), Ayush Nivesh Saarthi investment portal, and e-Charak marketplace for medicinal plants. Additional digital repositories like AMAR, SAHI and E-Medha digitize ancient Ayurvedic texts and manuscripts.
enrichment.context:
The Ayush Grid initiative reflects the broader Digital India and e-governance push to modernize traditional medicine systems (Ayurveda, Yoga, Unani, Siddha, Homeopathy) by integrating them with mainstream digital health infrastructure. Its interoperability with the Ayushman Bharat Digital Mission (ABDM) is significant because it links Ayush healthcare records with the national digital health ecosystem, enabling unified health IDs and interoperable patient records across allopathic and traditional systems. This mainstreaming effort aligns with government goals to promote Ayush systems domestically and globally, including AI-driven research repositories and investment facilitation portals aimed at attracting capital into the sector.

The initiative also addresses governance concerns such as transparency in scheme funding (Ayush Anudan Portal), market linkages for the medicinal plants sector (e-Charak), and preservation of traditional knowledge through digitization of ancient manuscripts (AMAR, SAHI, E-Medha), which ties into India's efforts to protect traditional knowledge from biopiracy and enable evidence-based validation of Ayush practices via AI/ML tools.

prelims_questions.question: The 'Ayush Hospital Management Information System (AHMIS)', mentioned in the context of the Ayush Grid project, is compliant with which of the following?
options: Digital India Land Records Modernisation Programme
prelims_questions.explanation: The release states AHMIS is compliant with the Ayushman Bharat Digital Mission (ABDM), integrating Ayush healthcare delivery with the national digital health ecosystem.

prelims_questions.question: Consider the following portals developed under the Ayush Grid initiative: 1. e-Charak 2. Ayush Nivesh Saarthi 3. MAISP. Which of the above is/are correctly matched with their primary function? 1 - Virtual marketplace for medicinal plants sector; 2 - Gateway for investors in Ayush sector; 3 - Master integrated portal of Ministry of Ayush.
prelims_questions.explanation: As per the release, e-Charak is a virtual marketplace for medicinal plants, Ayush Nivesh Saarthi is a gateway for investors, and MAISP is the master portal integrating all Ayush services, so all three matches are correct.

mains_questions.question: Discuss the significance of digitizing traditional medicine systems in India through initiatives like the Ayush Grid. How does integration with the Ayushman Bharat Digital Mission strengthen the healthcare ecosystem?

Examine the role of e-governance platforms in promoting transparency, research, and investment in India's traditional medicine (Ayush) sector, with reference to specific initiatives under the Ayush Grid.
